summary: Castor Maritime Inc. filed a 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing a completed joint venture (JV) transaction. It contributed its Kamsarmax bulk carrier, M/V Magic Starlight, to a JV with third-party investors arranged by Fearnley Securities AS, receiving a 30% equity stake and $18.75 million cash. The JV financed the acquisition with partner cash and an $11.5 million sustainability-linked senior loan, secured by a first-priority mortgage on the vessel and guaranteed by Castor. The transaction closed on August 6, 2026. Castor expects a net gain of approximately $2.9 million in Q3 2026. The filing reflects a partial divestiture of a vessel asset. Watch for fleet strategy and potential further JV monetizations.
